inspiration.observed_pattern: MariaDB exposes a broad scalar function surface spanning trigonometry, radix conversion, character conversion, checksums, null-control aliases, and date arithmetic.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as deterministic scalar probes for MySqweel's embeddable query engine. Fixed literals cover numeric domains, UTF-8 byte length, null branches, ISO week numbering, month-end clamping, date formatting, and epoch-second conversion; no source SQL, schema, or data was copied.

fixture_notes: Each statement isolates one function or a small compositional pair. Constants are selected so MariaDB's numeric, string, NULL, date, and UTF-8 byte semantics remain observable.
determinism_notes: Only fixed literals are used; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, filesystem access, or concurrent connections.

steps.sql: SELECT ACOS(1) AS acos_one, ASIN(1) AS asin_one, ATAN(1) AS atan_one, ATAN2(1, 1) AS atan2_one
SELECT BIN(10) AS binary_ten, OCT(10) AS octal_ten, CHR(65) AS letter
SELECT COS(0) AS cosine_zero, COT(1) AS cotangent_one, SIN(0) AS sine_zero, TAN(0) AS tangent_zero
SELECT CRC32C('x') AS castagnoli_x, DEGREES(PI()) AS degrees_pi, RADIANS(180) AS radians_180
SELECT LENGTHB('é') AS utf8_bytes, NVL(NULL, 5) AS nvl_value, NVL2(NULL, 1, 2) AS nvl2_value
SELECT ADD_MONTHS('2020-01-31', 1) AS month_end, TO_CHAR('2020-01-02', 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS formatted_date
SELECT TO_SECONDS('2020-01-02') AS epoch_seconds, WEEK('2020-01-05', 3) AS iso_week
SELECT TRIM_ORACLE(' x ') AS trim_alias, SUBSTR_ORACLE('abcd', 2, 2) AS substr_alias, LPAD_ORACLE('x', 3, '0') AS lpad_alias, RPAD_ORACLE('x', 3, '0') AS rpad_alias
SELECT LTRIM_ORACLE(' x') AS ltrim_alias, RTRIM_ORACLE('x ') AS rtrim_alias, REPLACE_ORACLE('abc', 'b', 'X') AS replace_alias, CONCAT_OPERATOR_ORACLE('a', 'b') AS concat_alias
SELECT SESSION_USER() AS session_user_alias, SYSTEM_USER() AS system_user_alias
